stop.command:
acr_hook_timeout=600
command -v python3 >/dev/null || {
printf '%s\n' 'ACR hook .cursor/hooks/acr__example__all-agents__stop/stop.sh (stop): could not run because Python >= 3.9 is unavailable; Install Python >= 3.9 on the agent PATH and retry.' >&2
printf '%s\n' '{}'
exit 0
}
[ -f .cursor/hooks/acr-hook.py ] && [ -r .cursor/hooks/acr-hook.py ] || {
printf '%s\n' 'ACR hook .cursor/hooks/acr__example__all-agents__stop/stop.sh (stop): runtime failure: translator failed; Check Python >= 3.9 on the agent PATH and run acr realize before retrying.' >&2
printf '%s\n' '{}'
exit 0
}
trap ':' TERM
acr_hook_output=$(
trap ':' TERM
acr_hook_timeout="$acr_hook_timeout" python3 -I .cursor/hooks/acr-hook.py cursor stop .cursor/hooks/acr__example__all-agents__stop/stop.sh
acr_hook_status=$?
printf '.'
exit "$acr_hook_status"
)
acr_hook_status=$?
case $acr_hook_status in
0) trap '' PIPE; printf '%s' "${acr_hook_output%.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 141; exit "$acr_hook_status" ;;
129|130|141|143) exit "$acr_hook_status" ;;
*)
printf '%s\n' 'ACR hook .cursor/hooks/acr__example__all-agents__stop/stop.sh (stop): runtime failure: translator failed; Check Python >= 3.9 on the agent PATH and run acr realize before retrying.' >&2
printf '%s\n' '{}'
exit 0
;;
esac
